In the intermittent meeting and negotiation scenarios, the quiet time in the middle can be automatically omitted to shorten the recording time.

title: Amazon Kindle Scribe Colorsoft 64GB (newest model) — 11” paper-like color display with front light — Thin, light, powerful — Write in notebooks, documents, and books. Includes Premium Pen - Graphite
bullet_points: Our most advanced Kindle Scribe – Features an 11” Colorsoft display with front light, built-in notebook, AI tools, and support for popular cloud services.
New Colorsoft display – A custom-built oxide-based display delivers high-contrast, paper-like color that’s easy on the eyes without distracting flashes when writing.
Feels just like paper – Textured surface and ultra-fast responsiveness for a natural writing experience. Included Premium Pen requires no charging.
Thin, light, fast – Just 5.4mm thin and 400g light with fluid performance and a large 11" display that gives you space to write, read, and think.

Built-in notebook with AI-powered tools - Find information even if you don't remember exact keywords, and ask questions about your notes to uncover insights. Generate summaries, refine your handwriting, or convert notes to text.
Docs on demand – Import documents from Google Drive and Microsoft OneDrive directly to your device to mark up. Export your notebooks to Microsoft OneNote.
Capture your thoughts in documents and books – Just start writing and Active Canvas creates space for your notes. Expand margins for more room or collapse them to see the original text.

AI reading features - Get Recaps on thousands of bestseller series. Coming in 2026: Story So Far for spoiler-free book catch-ups and Ask this Book for in-text questions—available on thousands of Kindle books.

title: ThePhotoStick® Omni X - 128GB - Secure Photo & Video Backup and Transfer | Digital File Organization | USB & Multiport Connection for Phones, Tablets and Computers | Portable Memory | External Storage
bullet_points: Protect Your Precious Memories — The New Standard in Photo Backup: ThePhotoStick Omni X is our most advanced and trusted backup solution, designed to securely store photos and videos from any device in one place.

Easy Backup for iPhone, Android, PC & Mac: Back up photos and videos directly from your iPhone, Android, Windows PC, or Mac using one compact USB flash drive. No technical skills required. Just plug it in, and the free companion app will find, sort, and store all of your files in one secure place

Reliable Offline Storage You Can Trust, No Internet Required: Unlike cloud-only backup services, ThePhotoStick Omni X stores your photos and videos directly on the device. No data usage. No ongoing subscription required. It’s a practical, secure way to keep control of your memories.

A thoughtful gift for any occasion – Give friends and family a simple way to relive a lifetime of memorable moments! ThePhotoStick Omni is perfect for sharing ALL of life's milestones in ONE special keepsake.

Huge Storage Capacity: Secure USB photo backup device stores up to 51,000 photos and videos. Perfect for backing up years of family memories, vacations, graduations, weddings, and everyday moments while freeing up space on your phone, tablet, or computer.
Compact, Durable, Take-Anywhere Design: Built with a strong metal alloy and small enough to fit on your keychain, ThePhotoStick Omni X keeps your backup safely with you wherever you go.

Broad File Format Support: Back up more than just photos and videos. ThePhotoStick Omni X can find and protect other common file types such as contacts, Word documents, PDFs, audio, and more. Keep every single memory and essential file safe for years to come.
System Requirements & Ports: Requires Android 8.0+, iOS/iPadOS 13.0+, Windows 7, SP1+, or macOS 10.13+. Includes USBA, USBC, microUSB, and Lightning connections.

title: msi PRO MP273Q E14 27-inch IPS 2560 x 1440 (QHD) Computer Monitor, 144Hz,Adaptive-Synch, HDMI, DP Port, VESA Mountable, Tilt, Speaker, 1ms, Black
bullet_points: MSI's 27-inch WQHD IPS gaming monitor (2560×1440) delivers a 1500:1 contrast ratio with wide 178°/178° viewing angles — producing 78% more pixels than Full HD for sharper detail, deeper blacks, and more accurate colors across gaming, productivity, and creative workflows.

TÜV Rheinland certified Flicker Free and Low Blue Light — eliminating the ~200Hz screen flicker common on standard monitors and reducing harmful blue light exposure to minimize eye strain and fatigue during extended gaming or work sessions.

144Hz high refresh rate delivers ultra-smooth motion and sharper tracking versus standard 60Hz or 75Hz monitors — keeping every frame fluid and responsive for fast-paced FPS, racing, and action games at WQHD 2560×1440 resolution without screen tearing or stuttering.

MSI's built-in Eye-Q Check provides a vision assessment tool to help optimize display settings for healthier long-term viewing — designed for professionals and students spending extended hours in front of a 27-inch WQHD IPS screen.

Tilt-adjustable stand (-5°~20°) for comfortable viewing at any desk setup, with VESA 100×100mm wall mount compatibility for monitor arms, brackets, and multi-monitor arrangements — reducing neck strain during extended WQHD gaming or productivity sessions.

MSI monitors support firmware updates to deliver the latest performance optimizations, compatibility improvements, and feature enhancements — keeping your 27-inch WQHD IPS gaming monitor performing at its best long after purchase.

Adaptive Sync (FreeSync compatible) dynamically matches the monitor's refresh rate to your GPU's frame output — eliminating screen tearing, stuttering, and input lag for consistently smooth, tear-free gameplay across the full WQHD 2560×1440 panel at 144Hz.

HDMI 2.0b with HDMI-CEC enables seamless single-remote device control across compatible displays and source devices. DisplayPort 1.2a delivers reliable high-bandwidth video output supporting WQHD 2560×1440 at 144Hz — flexible, high-performance connectivity for any setup.

bullet_points: 【Photo Scanner Built-In Storage】- This photo scanner for old pictures to digital fast lets you view and edit instantly on the 22MP 5-inch screen. With 16GB built-in storage, no SD card needed—scan, save, and share memories quickly and easily

【Effortless Film Loading via Quick-Feed Technology】- Experience smooth, continuous scanning with our digital film scanner, featuring advanced quick-load technology. It supports various film types including 135 Film, 126KPK Film, 110 Film, and Super 8 Film, as well as monochrome and slides. Each film type is accommodated with its own adapter, making this scanner as versatile as a complete film developing kit

【Enhanced Photo Editing Capabilities】- With a single touch, this photo scanner for old pictures to digital fast allows you to enhance, resize, and convert photos. The scanner also includes multilingual support, covering English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, and Japanese for added convenience

bullet_points: 【185° Ultra-Wide FOV】 Expand your perspective with a maximum 185° field of view, designed to capture more of the scene. Ensuring immersive and dynamic footage for both expansive landscapes and fast-paced action. Perfect for architectural photography, sweeping vistas, as well as surfing, mountain biking, skiing and skydiving.

【Perfect Compatibility】 Tailored for DJI Osmo Action 4 and Action 5 Pro cameras. Features a precision-engineered threaded mount that matches the original lens design, ensuring a secure, wobble-free fit during intense activities. Quick to install or remove without interfering with camera functions or other accessories.

【HD Optical Glass with Multi-Coating】 Crafted with high-definition optical glass and multiple layers of anti-reflective coating, this FOV boost lens delivers sharp, vibrant, and clear image quality. The advanced optical design minimizes reflections and glare, capturing every high-speed moment with professional precision.

【Protective Silicone Case Included】 Comes with a dedicated silicone protective cover for safe storage. When the lens is mounted, the case cover doubles as a lens cap to prevent scratches and impact damage, making it an essential accessory for travel and outdoor adventures.

bullet_points: 26% lighter than its predecessor, thanks to thinner lens elements and a reduction in the total number of elements in the optical design.
Internal zoom. Ideal for use with gimbals and matte boxes, with no change to center of gravity when zoom position is changed

Custom control. Control ring click on/off switch lets you choose between precise, incremental click adjustments for smooth, seamless changes. Close focus/high magnification. Focus as close as 15 inches at 70mm, with a maximum magnification of 0.3x. (WARNING: Do not use this product if you have a pacemaker or other medical device. The magnet or magnets in this product could cause medical devices to malfunction.)

title: 2Pcs Phone Jack to Ethernet Cable Adapter, RJ11 to RJ45 Adapter Male, RJ45 Female to RJ11 for Landline Telephone Service
bullet_points: Practical Phone Line Extension Solution: This RJ11 to RJ45 adapter set includes 2 adapter and 2 phone cables (each 0.5m / about 19.7 inches), allowing you to connect traditional telephones, fax machines, or DSL modems through existing Ethernet wall jacks. No need to modify your Ethernet port—just plug and use.

Simple Plug-and-Use Design: The RJ11 to RJ45 adapter features a snap-in retaining clip for a secure and stable connection. Ideal for homes or offices where only Ethernet wiring is available but no dedicated phone jack is installed.

Reliable Performance for Daily Use: Made with quality materials and contacts, this phone line to Ethernet adapter helps maintain clear voice transmission and reduces signal loss. Designed for everyday use in environments like hotels, schools, and residential spaces.

Flexible Connectivity for Fixed Devices: Whether you're connecting a landline phone or a fax machine, this RJ11 to RJ45 cable and adapter combo gives you the flexibility to use standard Ethernet cables for telephone service—simple and efficient.

Important Compatibility Note: Please note: This adapter is NOT for connecting to routers or transmitting internet signals via telephone lines. It is only intended for use with landline-based devices such as telephones or DSL modems when connected through a router with a phone jack. Not compatible with WiFi or broadband data transmission.

Premium Wooden Cabinet with Rechargeable Battery - Built with a premium acoustic wooden cabinet, full aluminium front panel and grille, plus an aluminium carry handle for easy portability. The inbuilt lithium battery provides over 10 hours of playtime and recharges via USB-C, giving flexible listening around the home without AA batteries.
